quests.title: The Unbowed One's Gratitude

dialogue.t: That should do it...
Let's see...
Close your eyes.
I've done all I could, but I'm by no means a professional.
If there are still flaws in the work, I don't want you to see them... So, please. Close your eyes.

dialogue.sit: Can I open my eyes now?

dialogue.t: Sorry, I got a little... emotional just now.
I suppose I wasn't expecting to hear such a beautiful melody from it after all this time.

dialogue.sit: (Ah... So she asked me to close my eyes earlier because she didn't want me to see her getting emotional...)

dialogue.t: ...Alright, if you can keep a secret.
I mentioned earlier that this was a birthday present. In truth, it's also the last birthday present I received from my mother.
It's... complicated. After that birthday, our family started to struggle financially, and life got busier and busier...
But most of all, my mother and I gradually drifted apart.
She always said that my dancing lacked emotional warmth, but I kept myself closed-off, and refused to listen to her guidance.
Now, I realize how childish that was. So, when I found this music box in the attic, it felt like a symbol of happier times.
But in a twist of irony, the melody it played was harsh and distorted... Almost like it was reminding me how much I've neglected it and my family all these years.
And now, I can't help but wonder...
If I can pluck a music box free from the grasp of time, might I be able to restore a relationship I wore away with my own hands?

dialogue.sit: That's a hard question to answer.
But it never hurts to try.

dialogue.t: I will.
In fact, I plan on doing so tonight.
But I should thank you first. While I originally had no intention of relying on help, the repairs only went so smoothly thanks to the materials you provided.
Besides, you've decorated this place so very elegantly. It really suits my taste.
Just a pity it won't scare off nosy theater-goers anymore.
I'll be sure to save you a ticket for my future shows.

quests.description: With these materials in hand, Odette should be able to repair her music box…
